audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] told you to build MR for Feast, which is true damage and ignores resistances entirely. Nothing said Feral Scream's silence stops Divine Judgment being cast, and no cooldown numbers appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Feast is true damage on an 80s rank-1 cooldown — MR is the wrong purchase and buying it gets players killed at the same HP they thought was safe. Feral Scream is an 11s silence, so if it lands first the ultimate never comes out.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0]/[1]/[2], dontsFull[1], breakdown.cooldowns and report[5] now carry the true-damage warning, the silence-blocks-R interaction and the 80s / 11s / 6s numbers.
